notes: Initial N-14 8C (filed June 22, 2021) for the reorganizations of NXQ and NXR into NXP; each reorganization closes independently ('The closing of each Reorganization is not contingent on the closing of the other Reorganization'). Common shares only; Target Fund holders receive newly issued Acquiring Fund common shares of equal aggregate NAV, struck at the close of regular NYSE trading on the business day before the Closing Date, with cash in lieu of fractional shares. The closing date ('on or about [ ], 2021'), the annual meeting date and the record date are all bracketed placeholders in this preliminary filing, so expected_close, meeting_date and record_date are null. The Agreement's termination article (Article XI) gives no outside date: termination is by mutual agreement, uncured breach, an unmet condition precedent, or a board determination that the reorganization is not in the fund's best interests, so termination_date is null. Conditions: shareholder approval, tax opinion and absence of legal proceedings come from the 'Conditions.' summary; regulatory consents (8.3) and registration effectiveness (8.4) from Article VIII of the form of Agreement (Appendix A); 'other' covers customary certificates and legal opinions. The Agreement also requires the Target Fund to declare a distribution of its undistributed income before the Valuation Time (8.5), which I did not map to a separate category. The text file renders cp1252 punctuation as control characters U+0091-U+0097; spans that include them use JSON \u escapes so they parse to the exact characters in the file.
